input.command: cd site && ls . css js && cat index.html && grep -rn "color" css | head -80
cd css && sed -n 95,108p base.css; sed -n 145,152p components.css; sed -n 214,219p components.css; grep -n "page-home\|lede\|muted" *.css

content.text:
On the home page, the grey descriptive text is now #3d4650. The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't check the page in a browser.

I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css` that overrides `--color-muted` to `#3d4650` under `.page-home`. The other pages keep the original `#59636e`.

The override changes every use of the muted colour on the home page, not just the hero line. That covers:
- the hero lede
- the text in the cards
- the stat labels
- the newsletter note

I assumed that was what you meant by "descriptive text". If you want only the hero line changed, I can narrow it.

STATUS: DONE
